name: Sysdig alert to custom Teams Adaptive Card (Preview)
description:
## What it does

Receives an authenticated Sysdig Monitor webhook and builds a custom Adaptive Card with alert status, scope, metrics, conditions, and trusted Sysdig links using **Webhook → Code → DevX Message Connector**.

## Setup

1. Add a **DevX Message Connector** credential containing the full Teams channel link and configure `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL` and `DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_KEY`.
2. Attach a **Header Auth** credential to the Webhook using header name `Authorization` and a dedicated shared secret. POST a sample to `/webhook-test/devx/sysdig-alert-card` with that header and inspect the Preview response.
3. Activate the workflow and configure the Sysdig channel with `/webhook/devx/sysdig-alert-card` and the exact same Authorization value. Change **Mode** to **Send** only after reviewing the card.

## Notes

This uses the custom Code-node formatter, not the connector's simpler **Template → Sysdig** mode in template `2009`. Preview calls `<DEVX_CONNECTOR_API_URL>/api/v1/messages/preview` without posting to Teams; it is not an offline transformation mode. The Webhook responds immediately, so acceptance does not confirm Teams delivery. The Code node is the exact script from the [source runbook](https://bcgov.github.io/common-hosted-workflow/operations/sysdig-alert-notifications). No credentials or pinned execution data are included.
